summary: Full frontend-only pass on Casa Güell single-page site. Tested header/nav/language toggle, hero, philosophy, menu (all 4 food tabs + Carta de Vins with 5 wine sub-tabs), signature-dish hover photo card (desktop), team grid, location (maps/phone/socials), booking drawer (CoverManager iframe + phone fallback + close via overlay), floating reserve button, footer, mobile (390px) nav & no horizontal overflow. Backend not tested (default template, out of scope).

integration_issues.issue: Clicking Vins nav link scrolls the wine tab button into view but does NOT activate the Carta de Vins tab, so user has to click it again to see wines. Consider setActiveTab('vins') on nav click.

issues: Google Maps embed area occasionally renders blank on first load in headless/preview (lazy iframe). Works when scrolled to, but consider eager loading or a static fallback.

action_items: (Optional) Wire nav-link-vins click to also setActiveTab('vins') in MenuSection so 'Vins' nav item shows wine list immediately.
(Optional) Consider removing loading='lazy' on maps iframe or use loading='eager' since it's below the fold and users navigate here explicitly.
critical_code_review_comments: MenuSection.jsx onMouseMove uses comma operator inside a && short-circuit which technically works but is unusual; consider wrapping in a block for readability.
Header logo scrollTo('hero') works because Hero has id='hero' – good. Consistency across sections is fine.
Language toggle correctly propagates across hero, nav, menu tabs, wine group labels, philosophy, team, location, footer, and booking drawer – verified in CA↔ES switch.
BookingDrawer overlay z-90 vs panel z-95: correct stacking. Close via overlay click confirmed. Iframe loads CoverManager URL properly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All data-testids present and consistent. Signature hover items are capipota, fricando, flam (guisats + postres tabs). Wine group keys: blancs/rosats/negres/escumosos/copes. Verified item counts: picar 14, guisats 14, peix 7, postres 7; wines 12/2/16/7/7. Only minor UX note: nav 'Vins' doesn't auto-activate wine tab.
